errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the years on the x-axis are in alphabetical order. They are in chronological order (2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020).
The description states the value for Vratsa (Враца) in 2016 is about 45%, but the bar in the chart is clearly above 50%, at approximately 53%.
The description states the value for Lovech (Ловеч) in 2016 is about 40%, but the bar in the chart is at the 50% line.
The description states the value for Montana (Монтана) in 2016 is about 50%, but the bar in the chart is visibly higher, at approximately 55%.
The description states the value for Vratsa (Враца) in 2020 is about 35%, but the bar in the chart is much closer to 40%, at approximately 39%.
